# Harbor status report style

The weekly status report of the Harbor project (DemoConsult for DemoFoods). The delivery manager approves it before it reaches the client.

## Steps

1. Start from `template.md` in this folder. Keep its title, header table and eight sections, in the same order. Do not add or remove sections.
2. Set the RAG status by the rules in `requirements/report-spec.md` only. Under the header table, say which rule decided it, in one sentence.
3. Quote every risk, issue and decision with its RAID ID from `raid/raid-log.md`, and every issue and pull request with its number (#12). Never invent an ID.
4. Write "not known yet" for anything missing, and add it to "What we need from DemoFoods".
5. Put this line above the title: "Draft: the delivery manager approves this report before it reaches the client."

## Style

- One page.
- Plain, short sentences. The reader may not be a native English speaker.
- Facts first, no sales language. Bad news as clearly as good news.
- Project weeks ("Week 7"), not words like "soon" or "shortly".
